en.title: Gift Deed and Hiba of Property in Bangladesh
en.directAnswer: A gift transfers property without an ordinary sale price. Hiba is a Muslim-law concept and should not be treated as the same thing as every type of gift. Formal requirements can depend on the type of property, the parties and the legal form used.

atAGlance.whoFor: A family wants to transfer property without a normal sale.

en.lawMeaning:
Do not use one standard “gift deed” answer for every family. Registration, declaration, acceptance and possession issues can matter.

This page gives a general route. A person’s exact rights can change because of facts, documents, deadlines, legal status, court orders or later amendments.
steps: Confirm the donor owns the property.
Identify whether the intended transfer is a statutory gift, hiba or another form.
Record acceptance and other required facts.
Update land records after the transfer.
evidence: Relevant official notices, receipts, and correspondence
en.simpleExample: A father wants to give one property to one child. Before signing anything, he should confirm title, the correct legal form and the effect on other family rights.
commonMistakes: Using a sale deed when there is no sale.
gifting property the donor does not fully own.
